author: external-contracts-producer
scope: Selected critical S1–S5 boundaries; not an exhaustive repository import/call graph and not a campaign execution report.

definitions.build: Consumer -> source/module/generation input required by declared imports or generation recipe; compile, type and package edges are not execution evidence. These are product-module/generation dependencies, not a claim about Genesis artifact build_dependencies.
definitions.call: Caller/dispatch contract -> callee contract as written in source. No runtime request was sent.
definitions.navigation: Discovery/reference -> information reachable through an explicit read/resolution interface. Never automatically a build dependency. Unit-to-unit links in actual campaign knowledge were not inspected and are not invented here.
definitions.impact: Changed producer/contract -> potentially affected consumer; bounded static inference based on traced edges.

ownership_rule.algorithm: exact_files[path] > longest matching directory_prefix ending in / > fallback S5

edges.mechanism: serve.ts importa createRoutes e o fornece a HttpRouter.serve; routes.ts declara createRoutes e monta HttpApiBuilder.layer.
edges.limit: Import/chamada escrita em fonte; nenhum servidor foi iniciado.
